decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical Windows 386 interface definitions used by core DOS and BIOS.
evidence: The file is byte-identical to DOS 6.0 and astro.
DOS MSCODE uses multiplex numbers and subfunctions; DOS MSINIT uses the Win386_IIS structure size, while BIOS MSINT13 uses multiplex and initialization constants.
Reviews 083 and 090 compare the corresponding DOS modules to inferred target ranges, with listed differences attributed to relocations.
A targeted lexical search found no NT/BOP markers.
limitations: Prior comparisons support exercised definitions only; alternative paths, relocation values, target alignment and full linked identity remain unverified.
